title: Xerxes and Alexander visited the sites
summary: Matt tells of Xerxes and Alexander visited the sites, about 5th–4th century BC at Lake Van region, Turkey, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: for instance these sites were visited by Xerxes Alexander the Great and many many other great people throughout history

plain: A researcher called Matt, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, talks about ancient sites around Lake Van in eastern Turkey. Matt says that famous figures of the ancient world visited these sites, among them Xerxes, a Persian king, and Alexander the Great, along with many other important people over the centuries. He gives no source for this, and he tells it to show how long these places have been seen as special.
